approval_source.question_set: Production activation v1, step A6: where the governed basic transfer range lives

decisions.question: D04-Q01, D11-Q03
decisions.rule: The approved range of the basic transfer (0.1 to 10 DRT) is the genesis governance bound parameter_bounds.reference_send_fee_udrt. A fee-profile proposal is refused unless a reference basic Send (one ML-DSA-65 signature and one Send between existing accounts, at fixed sizes measured from a real Send) costs a fee inside it under the proposed values, at the genesis minimum gas; the genesis fee profile must also sit inside it. Test chains set their own bound.
